queries.name: Cobertura de indexação
queries.description: LEFT JOIN encontra registros sem índice.
queries.sql: SELECT count(*) AS pendentes FROM items i LEFT JOIN knowledge_memory m ON i.source=m.source AND i.id=m.id WHERE m.id IS NULL

queries.name: Temas indexados
queries.sql: SELECT i.source,i.id,i.title,m.topics,i.source_url FROM items i JOIN knowledge_memory m ON i.source=m.source AND i.id=m.id WHERE m.topics LIKE '%Programação%' LIMIT 100
